content.value_statement: Weak authentication or sender signals can route legitimate email to spam. This skill turns available evidence into a structured pre-send deliverability assessment.
actual_capabilities: Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and optional BIMI evidence for presence, alignment, and reported passing status.
Classifies authentication as pass, partial, veto-candidate, or needs input.
Reviews domain and IP reputation evidence from ESP reports, Google Postmaster Tools, or Microsoft SNDS.
Assesses seed-list inbox placement across inbox, promotions, and spam outcomes.
Scans email content for risky phrasing, link problems, missing plain text, image imbalance, and rendering issues.
Scores the SEND-S dimension and summarizes hard-bounce and spam-complaint rates.
limitations: Requires current DNS, DMARC aggregate, ESP, reputation, and seed-test evidence for a complete assessment.
Does not send test messages or guarantee placement by any mailbox provider.
Does not compute the full Email Quality Score or make final consent and campaign veto decisions.
Provides a point-in-time hygiene snapshot, not recurring bounce and complaint trend monitoring.

use_cases.title: Validate a New Sending Domain
use_cases.description: Review authentication records and available DMARC evidence before increasing email volume.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Poor Inbox Placement
use_cases.description: Compare seed-test results, reputation signals, creative risks, and list metrics to identify likely causes.

use_cases.title: Approve a Campaign Pre-flight
use_cases.description: Produce a structured readiness report with evidence gaps and remediation priorities before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Authentication Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI for [domain]. Use this DNS export: [paste or path]. Mark missing evidence clearly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a focused review of authentication setup.

prompt_templates.title: Campaign Deliverability Pre-flight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a pre-send deliverability review for [domain]. Profile: [profile]. Review my DNS, DMARC report, ESP metrics, seed test, and email HTML.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess a campaign using the main evidence sources.

prompt_templates.title: Inbox Placement Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why mail from [domain] reaches promotions or spam. Compare this seed test, reputation report, complaint rate, bounce rate, and creative.
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate placement problems across technical and content signals.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced SEND-S Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Score SEND-S for [domain] under the [profile] profile. Set the S1 flag, cite each measurement, list evidence gaps, and prepare an auditor handoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a detailed assessment for a downstream quality audit.

output_examples.input: Review example.com using an aligned SPF record, aligned DKIM, DMARC p=none, and a passing aggregate report.
output_examples.output: Authentication: Partial. SPF and DKIM are aligned and passing. DMARC exists at p=none, so S1 is partial rather than a veto-candidate.

output_examples.input: Assess a seed test with 72% inbox, 20% promotions, 8% spam, a 0.04% complaint rate, and no reputation report.
output_examples.output: Inbox placement: Partial. List hygiene: Pass for complaints. Reputation: NEEDS_INPUT. Obtain current domain and IP reputation before declaring send readiness.

output_examples.input: Scan an image-only campaign with shortened links, no plain-text part, and a broken Outlook layout.
output: Link risk: shortened destinations require replacement and validation.
Message structure: add a plain-text alternative.

best_practices: Provide recent evidence from the same sending domain and campaign window.
Separate measured facts from inferred causes and mark missing evidence as NEEDS_INPUT.
Run a fresh seed test after authentication, content, or list changes.
anti_patterns: Do not mark authentication as passing from DNS records without DMARC aggregate evidence.
Do not treat the Promotions tab as equivalent to spam without engagement and placement context.
Do not use a one-time snapshot as a substitute for recurring hygiene monitoring.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a DNS export, DMARC aggregate report, ESP deliverability metrics, reputation data, a seed test, and campaign HTML when available.

faq.question: Can this skill verify live DNS records?
faq.answer: It can use a documented local DNS connector when available, or assess a DNS export that you provide.

faq.question: Does it guarantee inbox placement?
faq.answer: No. Mailbox providers change filtering decisions, so the skill reports measured evidence and risk rather than a guarantee.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The affected item is marked NEEDS_INPUT. The skill does not assign a passing result by default.

faq.question: Does it make the final send decision?
faq.answer: No. It scores SEND-S and sets an S1 status for a separate email quality auditor to evaluate.

faq.question: Does it monitor deliverability over time?
faq.answer: No. It provides a point-in-time pre-flight and routes recurring hygiene or complaint trend work to a monitoring workflow.
